mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_wx_member WHERE deleted_flag = 0) AS memberCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_wx_member WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND create_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND create_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS todayMemberCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(member_id, helper_member_id), GREATEST(member_id, helper_member_id)) FROM t_helper WHERE deleted_flag = 0) AS helperPairCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_task WHERE deleted_flag = 0) AS taskCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_task WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND create_time >= CURRENT_DATE AND create_time < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS todayTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_task WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND status = 3) AS completedTaskCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id AND t.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.status = 2 AND p.complete_time IS NOT NULL) AS completedParticipantCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id AND t.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.status = 2 AND p.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND p.complete_time <= t.deadline) AS onTimeParticipantCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_app_feedback WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND status = 0) AS pendingFeedbackCount
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_task WHERE deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT member_id AS memberId, nickname, avatar, create_time AS createTime, last_login_time AS lastLoginTime FROM t_wx_member WHERE deleted_flag = 0 ORDER BY member_id DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_wx_member WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_task WHERE deleted_flag = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.complete_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id AND t.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.status = 2 AND p.complete_time >= #{startTime} AND p.complete_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(p.complete_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate
